thread:
maria_cust: Hey support — I just got added to Acme's org via SSO but when I try to open the project console I get a 403. CLI/API also returns 403 for project endpoints. Can someone help?

maria_cust: Repro steps I used: 1) SSO sign-in, 2) click Projects > acme-prod, 3) console shows "Permission denied". API: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/proj-9abc` returns: 
```
{"error":"permission_denied","message":"403: insufficient_scope: missing role 'project:viewer' for project proj-9abc"}
```

devon_support: Thanks for the details, Maria. Sorry about the interruption. A few quick checks: are you getting added to an org-level role (Owner/Admin) or is this a group->role mapping via SAML/SCIM? Also can you paste the org id?

maria_cust: It's an SSO group mapping. I think the IdP team mapped groups last night. Org id is `0xFA23`. Email maria@acme.example.com

casey_platform: looping in platform/identity. @idp-bot can you show last role-sync logs for org 0xFA23?

idp-bot: role-sync job for org 0xFA23 ran at 2026-03-15T12:04:10Z — status: partial_failure. Summary: 2 group mappings applied, 1 failed (group 'acme-devs' -> role 'project:editor') due to missing mapping in IdP assertion. Error snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T12:04:07Z ERROR role-sync org=0xFA23 group=acme-devs mapping=project:editor reason="missing SAML attribute 'groups' for user"
```

casey_platform: Looks like the SAML assertion for Maria didn't include the 'groups' claim (common when IdP changed attribute name). If the mapping is missing on the assertion, RBAC won't grant the project role and you'll see 403s. Two options: fix IdP to include groups attribute (recommended) or grant a temporary project role via admin CLI while they sort IdP.

devon_support: To confirm it's an assertion issue, can you paste the response for `whoami` with your key? It shows scopes and derived roles. Run: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/whoami
```

maria_cust: here's the whoami response (redacted):
```
{"email":"maria@acme.example.com","org_roles":[],"project_roles":[],"scopes":["read:usage"]}
```

devon_support: Yep — no org/project roles. That confirms a role-mapping omission. Casey, can platform trigger a manual role sync/force? We should also patch IdP mapping so future logins include `groups` attribute named `memberOf` -> Redwood 'groups' mapping.

casey_platform: I can run a manual sync now. Running the internal tool: 
```
# run from infra tools
./bin/rw-role-sync --org 0xFA23 --force --trace
```

casey_platform: Sync returned: applied 2 mappings, 1 failed (acme-devs). Failure reason: SAML attribute name mismatch. Temporary workaround I applied: granted project role directly via admin tool for maria@acme.example.com so she can access the console while IdP team fixes mapping: 
```
./bin/rw-admin grant-role --org 0xFA23 --project proj-9abc --user maria@acme.example.com --role project:viewer --reason "support temporary grant"
```

oncall-bot: action logged: admin-grant by casey_platform at 2026-03-15T12:10:14Z (audit id audit-7f2b)

maria_cust: Trying now... refresh... ✅ console loads. API call to projects returns 200 now. Thanks!

devon_support: Great — glad that's back. Casey, please coordinate with the Acme IdP team to add groups to the assertion or map the attribute name. Also we should set a 10min TTL on temporary grants so they auto-expire.

casey_platform: Will do. Suggested permanent fix instructions for IdP: in SAML assertion, include groups under attribute `memberOf` (or update Redwood mapping to accept `groups`/`memberOf`), ensure SCIM sync includes group membership, then re-run `./bin/rw-role-sync --org 0xFA23`. Example SAML attribute: 
```
<Attribute Name="memberOf">
  <AttributeValue>acme-devs</AttributeValue>
</Attribute>
```

devon_support: Also documenting repro and fix steps in the support KB: 1) Run `whoami` to confirm missing roles. 2) Check role-sync job logs in Console -> Org -> Role Mappings. 3) If sync failed due to missing attribute, ask IdP to include group claim or update mapping. 4) Admins can apply a temporary grant: `rw-admin grant-role ...` (audit tracked). 5) Re-run role-sync and wait ~5-10min for propagation.

maria_cust: Thanks everyone. IdP team will update SAML attr name and follow up. Appreciate the temporary grant.

devon_support: Closing the thread in a bit — flagging as resolved unless you see the 403 again. :thumbsup:
